# Firmware tool provenance

Upstream: https://github.com/mischa85/elektron-firmware-tool
Local source snapshot HEAD: a5bce9a6af644386d900924082993a805e812874
Source files copied from the OS 1.12 port's tool used to package RC16. MIT license and independent-implementation provenance retained alongside the source. Only C sources, headers and documentation are included; no upstream tests, firmware samples, object files or prebuilt executable are copied. The app's tool is rebuilt for arm64 and x86_64.
